title: sprite.ts: shape/text/bitmap with filters missing PlaceFlagMove on posChanged
description:
In sprite.ts (encodeSprite), the posChanged branch emits PlaceObject3WithFilters for shape, text, and bitmap display objects but forgets to pass move=true. This means HasCharacter is set and HasMove is NOT set — Ruffle treats the tag as a new placement, allocates a new character at that depth, and doubles up the display list object instead of updating the existing one.

Affected lines (posChanged branch, else block around line 410):
- shape with filters (line ~424): encodePlaceObject3WithFilters(charId, depth, x, y, filters!, objTransform) — missing move=true as 9th argument
- text with filters (line ~433): encodePlaceObject3WithFilters(charId, depth, x, y, filters!) — missing move=true
- bitmap with filters (line ~459): encodePlaceObject3WithFilters(charId, depth, x, y, filters!) — missing move=true
- bitmap with blendMode (line ~458): encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode(charId, depth, x, y, blendMode, filters, undefined, undefined, bmpCXForm) — missing move=true as 10th argument

The instance type (line ~479-480) correctly passes move=true. Fix: pass true as the move parameter in each of the above calls.

Note: compile.ts has a parallel bug for shapes with filters (see separate task).
